title: Mild Indian Cauliflower Curry
subtitle: with Lentils, Snow Peas and Basmati
description: Loaded with cauliflower, split lentils and snow peas cooked in a lightly spiced paste, this creamy vegan curry hits the spot for those who prefer things on the mild side. Top with coriander and serve with basmati rice.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Cut the cauliflower stem into 1cm chunks, then cut the head into small florets (see Kitchen 101). Trim the stems from the snow peas, removing the strings from one side. Pick the coriander leaves and finely chop the stems.

Brown cauliflower: Heat 1 tbs vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the cauliflower, stirring occasionally, for 5 mins or until golden. Remove from the pan. Add the coriander stems, curry paste and 2 tbs tomato paste to the pan and cook, stirring, for 30 secs or until fragrant. Add 500ml (2 cups) water and stir until combined.

Simmer curry: Add the lentils to the pan and bring to the boil. Cover, then reduce the heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, for 15 mins or until slightly thickened. Meanwhile, fill a medium saucepan three-quarters full with water and bring to the boil. Add the rice and cook for 12 mins or until tender. Drain.

Finish curry: Stir the coconut milk into the curry and bring to a simmer. Add the cauliflower and cook, covered, for 3-4 mins until tender. Add the snow peas and cook, covered, for 2 mins or until tender. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.
Serve up: Divide the rice and curry among bowls. Scatter over the coriander leaves and enjoy!
Kitchen 101: Once you remove the centre stem from the cauliflower, it will naturally fall apart into large florets. You can then use your knife to break these down into smaller, bite-sized florets.
